gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same failed boundary-flux estimate in the mesh-dependent norm: applying the cut-trace and interpolation bounds yields h^{2r-2}, not the theorem's claimed h^{2r}, for nonempty Gamma_u. It also recognizes the resulting one-order loss and supplies the corresponding corrected theorem rate and qualification of the convergence claim.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The theorem's h^{2r} contribution for the gamma h^{-1}-weighted boundary normal-flux error is unsupported on nonempty flux boundaries because the trace estimate gives h^{2r-2}; consequently the advertised optimal convergence rate must be degraded and qualified.

component_coverage.gold_component: The claimed h^{2r} boundary-flux contribution is incompatible with the gamma h^{-1}-weighted trace term on nonempty Gamma_u; the proof supports h^{2r-2}, with the associated one-order loss and required qualification of the convergence claim.
